field_principles.cache_state_rows: Explicit hits and misses prevent an absent model from becoming silent evidence.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured elapsed time bounds the cost and makes implausible runtime claims visible.
field_principles.field_principles: Each required field states the evidence principle that justifies it.
field_principles.forged_receipt_rejection_rows: Critical mutations demonstrate that attribution checks fail closed.
field_principles.fresh_process_recheck_rows: A separate interpreter tests claims without trusting producer state.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked result reports the expected and observed gate values.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix makes completion or blockage machine-readable.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate separates live local CUDA inference from fixtures and hosted services.
field_principles.model_concurrency_rows: Recomputed lifecycles prove the models loaded one at a time.
field_principles.model_file_rows: File paths and hashes bind model names to the exact local weights used.
field_principles.model_rows: One terminal row per model preserves successes and failures without survivorship bias.
field_principles.model_specs: A fixed model set prevents a smaller substitute from satisfying the qualification.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hardware claims start only after falsifiable resource checks pass.
field_principles.process_lineage_rows: Kernel process identities prove that each inference child belongs to this task.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes the bounded generation request reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum binds the date, models, devices, sources, and seed.
field_principles.rows: Canonical receipt rows keep raw phase evidence available for independent replay.
field_principles.runner_selection_rows: Runner identity and commands distinguish executed code from a label.
field_principles.server_lifecycle_rows: Start and stop events expose the full lifetime of each model worker.
field_principles.sota_runtime_receipt_ready_score: One requires all three task-owned dual-CUDA model receipts and fresh replay.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Source hashes bind the result to the code and prior receipt it qualifies.
field_principles.task_gpu_telemetry_rows: PID-linked GPU samples prove residency, utilization, and requested offload.
field_principles.task_phase_timing_rows: Monotonic phase intervals support ordering and duration reconstruction.
field_principles.task_runtime_receipt: The complete serialized receipt lets later tasks repeat the independent check.
field_principles.teardown_rows: Exit, reap, and post-exit residency checks reveal leaked worker processes.
field_principles.verdict_class: The verdict class keeps an advisory receipt separate from a science result.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False keeps infrastructure validation outside scientific authority.
